about_the_game:
The main game and other DLC already added a lot of pretty girls, monsters, creatures, aliens, robots etc into your game play, but the cool life in the completely new space station could not be without cyberpunk men characters.

With this Cyberpunk men DLC you will get 10 handsome undressable male characters with working genitals, and settings to make their bodies even better.

They are different, with the different clothes, hairstyle etc to give you a better choice.

Fully functional genitals means that their penises are very realistic, and you can manage their size and erection with settings according to your idea and situation.

All content of this DLC will be available directly from the game, in the Play mode you can add new characters on scene and in the NPC menu you can give them commands.

Please note that content of this DLC will be updating. After buying the DLC you will get all updates for free.

content_descriptors.notes: In this DLC users can make the characters completely naked. Characters have working genitals.
